warrior-buy.label: Warrior, level 12, 16000 gold (needs #560)
warrior-buy.explanation: Original: the general Black Market rule wants 20000 gold below level 15; the rod is rejected. Corrected: the exception accepts the rod and records the 15000 target, but the shop step still does not buy it because the rod adds no power without #560 (buy_useful=0). Both fail the buy contract here; with #560's correction applied (stacked/), the corrected Borg buys the rod.
